pr_title: Improve logging for unavailable sonos hosts
pr_body:
Sonos logs warning messages every 1 minute 12 seconds for hosts that are not on-line.  This fixes the issue and the warning will be logged the first time, and subsequent logs messages will be at DEBUG level

issue_context.title: Sonos - repeated warning messages on unavailable manually specified hosts
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When manually specifying hosts in configuration.yaml and the host becomes unavailable warning messages are logged every 1 minute 12 seconds.  The expected behavior is the warning should be logged once as described in the Integration Quality Scale document

"This integration is able to cope when things go wrong. It will not print any exceptions nor will it fill the log with retry attempts."

https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/integration_quality_scale_index

The specific use case, is when I leave my house for an extended period of time, I unplug the Sonos devices to save power.  The system is running in docker within a bridge network; hence the need to specify the IP addresses (thank you!).  When it was not running in a bridge network these repeated errors did not occur.  So this behavior is specific to specifying the hosts manually.

I'm creating a pull request to fix the issue


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023-3-1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

sonos

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sonos/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
sonos:
  media_player:
    hosts:
      - 192.168.1.180
```
